_comment: Roger's risk appetite. Edit these numbers, not the code. Proposed defaults 2026-10-16, pending sign-off.
_conditional_band_comment: A metric that misses its threshold by <= 15% (relative) is CONDITIONAL, beyond that it is a FAIL.

country_hurdle_uplift._comment: Added to the equity IRR / yield hurdle. Tier by sovereign rating + FX convertibility.

kill_risks: single point of failure with no mitigant (offtaker, grid connection, sole permit)
sanctions or AML exposure on counterparty
FX non-convertibility with no hedge or USD-indexed revenue
sponsor model cannot be reconciled to its own stated outputs
leverage on collateral with lender right to re-margin at discretion and no cure period
leverage proceeds in an asset that cannot be liquidated within the margin-cure period (gated/quarterly fund) with no outside liquidity reserve

_metric_notes.min_dscr_amort: min DSCR over amortising years only; grace/ramp years reported separately in the memo
_metric_notes.excess_vs_benchmark: equity IRR (or expected return) minus the risk-free / money-market alternative the user would otherwise hold; not country-uplifted
_metric_notes.ltv0_lending: loan / (market value x weighted advance rate) — the lender's own test
_metric_notes.carry_spread: yield on what the loan buys - expected loss - loan rate (montecarlo: proceeds_yield)
_metric_notes.p_equity_loss: P(MOIC < 1) from simulate_project with event risks ON (tenant default, FX steps, exit multiple dispersion)
